title: Style Transfer as Bias Mitigation: Diffusion Models for Synthetic Mental Health Text for Arabic

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the mitigation of male-dominated dataset imbalance through male-to-female text style transfer. The stylistic divergence and semantic fidelity of the generated Arabic text are measured using metrics like BERTScore, ROUGE, and BLEU, alongside an LLM-based gender annotator to classify and verify the gendered linguistic patterns in the model outputs.
